releaseNotes: Note PIN lock setup and unlock proceed automatically after four digits. Turning Lock Off now removes the lock immediately after the correct PIN, without an extra OK confirmation. Existing notes, photos, PIN data, and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Diary recovery safeguard: if the main Notes list is empty but the local IndexedDB safety copy still contains Notes, restore that copy before saving a new snapshot. Existing Notes and app identity are preserved.
